case01.mail.nova.subject: Review required: new device sign-in
case01.mail.nova.preview: We detected a sign-in from an unfamiliar device…
case01.mail.nova.body:
Hello,

We detected a sign-in to your Nova Bank account from an unfamiliar device in Rotterdam. For your protection, access to some account features may be limited.

Please review this activity today. If we do not receive confirmation, your account may remain restricted.

Nova Bank Security Team
case01.mail.digest.subject: Your weekly security digest
case01.mail.digest.preview: Three short ways to keep your accounts safer this week.
case01.mail.digest.body: This week's reminder: slow down when a message creates urgency. Verify unexpected requests using contact details you found independently.
case01.mail.energy.subject: Your September statement is ready
case01.mail.energy.preview: Your latest energy statement is now available.
case01.mail.energy.body: Your September energy statement is ready. Your direct debit remains unchanged, so no action is required.
tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to Trust Protocol
tutorial.welcome.body: This is a simulated computer. Everything you see belongs to the fictional investigation—no real banking details or external services are used.
tutorial.desktop.title: Your desktop is the investigation space
tutorial.desktop.body: Select an application icon to open it. Windows can be dragged, minimized, restored from the taskbar, or closed without removing the application.
tutorial.compare.title: Verify before you act
tutorial.compare.body: Messages can sound convincing. Use different applications to compare names, addresses and claims. The game will respond to what you inspect and what you choose to do.
day01.call.suspicious.intro: Good morning, this is the bank's security team. We sent an important confirmation message to your email inbox.
day01.call.suspicious.instruction: Please open Mail and select the confirmation link in our message. I will remain on the line while you complete it.
day01.call.suspicious.nagOne: Have you completed the confirmation? My system still does not show any activity from your side.
day01.call.suspicious.nagTwo: Please do it now. I cannot secure the account until you open the email and use the confirmation link.
day01.call.police.name: Fraud Investigation Unit
day01.call.police.stop: Wait!!!!! Do not continue with that confirmation.
day01.call.police.explanation: We are monitoring a fraud group impersonating bank employees. They call people and pressure them to open a confirmation link sent by email. Do not submit anything on that page.
